aboutText: At Pro Power Solutions Co., based in Greensborough, we understand that electrical work is more than just wires and switches—it’s about safety, efficiency, and reliability. Our experienced team has been serving Melbourne's north-east for over a decade, providing top-notch service and high-quality workmanship for every project. From homes to businesses, we ensure all electrical needs are met with professionalism and care.
servicesText: Pro Power Solutions Co. offers a full range of electrical services, from new installations to emergency repairs. We specialise in residential, commercial, and industrial electrical work, ensuring safety and compliance with Australian standards across Greensborough and surrounds.
